title: Conformance certificate payload
description: The payload of a conformance certificate: a JWS (RFC 7515) in the compact serialization, signed with Ed25519 (alg EdDSA, RFC 8037), whose protected header carries `alg`, `typ` (`veredictum-certificate`) and the `kid` of the signing key. The verifying keys are a JWK Set (RFC 7517) published beside the instrument (`jwks.schema.json`). The payload names what was measured and by which instrument, and the SHA-256 digests of the run's results document and HAR recording, so the recorded exchanges a certificate covers are checkable byte for byte.

issued_at.description: When the certificate was issued (RFC 3339). A key's `expires_at` is compared against it.

version.description: The engine version, which both judged the run and issued the certificate.

status.description: The approval status of the instrument that wrote this document, derived from its own version: pre-approval for every 0.x version, which the openEHR SEC has not approved, and sec-approved from 1.0.0, which marks that approval.

sut.description: The SUT identity. A field the server stated in its ITS-REST System OPTIONS document (specifications/operations/options.yaml, schemas/others/Options.yaml) carries the server's value with source `server`; the operator supplies only the name or version the server did not state (source `operator`). `vendor` and `restapi_specs_version` are present only when the server stated them.

base_url.description: The base URL the run drove.

document.description: The results document's own name: `catalogue` for a run over every document, or the one document a narrower run drove.

digest.description: The catalogue revision: the SHA-256 of the `sha256sum` lines of every regular file under the catalogue root, each named by its `/`-separated relative path, sorted by the bytes of that path.

verdict.description: The verdict summary. The five counts partition the rows of the results document.

outcome.description: `green` when no row failed outside the advisory ones and no row errored, `red` otherwise.

failed.description: Failed rows that bear on the verdict.

advisory.description: Failed rows whose criterion is a SHOULD, which never count against a capability.

errored.description: Rows the instrument could not judge.

skipped.description: Skipped rows, each with its reason in the results document.

results.description: The SHA-256 of the run's `results.json`, byte for byte.

recording.description: The SHA-256 of the run's HAR recording, byte for byte.
